status: VERIFIED within the finite declared scope
claim: The generic Dynamic shared-arm bulk/physical/table route composes scalar JSON-bearing actual envelopes through existing BinaryValueCodec and BinaryJsonValueCodec, without Object bindings or product-specific codecs.

admission.nominal: Dynamic-bearing bulk nominal declarations remain JSON-free; legal scalar-owner actual descriptors may contain JSON in the implicit SharedVariant String arm.
admission.opt_in: Default-false allow_json option on specialized Dynamic child helpers; only two current production BinaryBulkEncoder/Decoder SharedVariant call sites pass true. Public/internal by convention, not access control.
admission.ordinary_json: W212 ordinary JSON actuals retain exact Object leaf bindings; no ordinary-arm binding guard removed.
admission.inherited_context: Scalar descriptor/value parsing retains occurrence depth and the same operation budget; outer owner charges final wire bytes once and reserves pending String framing.
admission.occurrence_law: P=physical parent rows, Q=Dynamic occurrences, R=selected SharedVariant arm values. NULL has no compact String entry; empty Array(JSON) is a selected value. All physical .mrk2 third-word rows remain P, with terminal zero.

architecture.reason: SharedVariant payloads already carry binary descriptor plus scalar serde. Reuse recursive wrappers and stateful leaf owners instead of one serializer/class per product.
architecture.rollback: Revert only the coherent local feature commit; no remote push or source-data mutation.
architecture.retained_consumers: Default helpers, generic borrowed envelopes, legacy DynamicValueCodec and Object shared MAP/Copy/document consumers retain their JSON fences.

source_lineage.recipe: Unique sorted paths; records [path,File.size,SHA256(file)]; SHA256(JSON.pretty_generate(records) + newline).
source_lineage.continuity: Core production/spec bytes restored after four separate defect seeds. Final helper builds/selftests use the same core and final Crystal helper; subsequent changes affect only Ruby invocation metadata and are qualified by fresh native matrices. Documentation and packet are outside the globs.
